title: Chinese University of Hong Kong to offer free AI dementia screening to 2,700 seniors
description: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) will launch its first free, district-based dementia screening programme next year, using artificial intelligence (AI)-powered retinal imaging to detect early signs of cognitive decline in 2,700 older residents within two years. The programme will be implemented in Wong Tai Sin, which has the highest proportion of elderly residents among Hong Kong’s 18 districts. title: Google's use of press by AI chatbot may infringe copyright rules, EU court adviser says
description: An adviser to Europe's highest court said on Tuesday that the use of press publications by Google's GOOGL.O artificial intelligence chatbot Gemini may in certain circumstances infringe copyright rules.
